Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted __based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A method, comprising: encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted __based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960).

Claim 17 (Currently amended): An apparatus, comprising: a decoder (400) for decoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted __based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence.

Claim 33 (Currently amended): A non-transitory computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted __based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence.
